summary:
Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers and the engine-free plot function, and rewired the three ignite adapters onto them. Nothing was executed: no tests, no flake8, no installs, and no commits, as requested. Lint was checked by reading only (line length, whitespace, file endings, unused imports).

Changes:
- New monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver): ordered cache, save/save_batch/finalize, overwrite=false merge per spec.
- New monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver): save/save_batch, private static _create_file_basename, dtype None keeps data dtype.
- monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py: added plot_2d_or_3d_image; existing GIF helpers untouched.
- monai/data/nifti_writer.py: default dtype is now np.float32.
- monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, tensorboard_handlers.py: thin adapters delegating in one call. Classification registers an engine-accepting _finalize wrapper.
- Renamed output_path to output_dir in tests/integration_sliding_window.py and both segmentation_3d evaluation examples.
- Tests: new test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename.

Open items: the NIfTI tests rely on nibabel get_data_dtype(); the TensorBoard handler error wording matches the original, including its existing mislabeling of the first message.
